text_block_list.text: On our way back from going out together—

Mejiro Ryan stopped in her tracks and 
stared intently at the display window.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Ryan-chan and Trainer! What a 
coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heeey, Ryan-chan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wah!? Y-Yes!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, huh? When did you get here, Ines?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"You really hadn't noticed, huh? How 
mean."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Now then, what caught your eye? Let's 
have a look-see~...?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Waah~! Cute clothes! It's kinda like a 
maid outfit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? N-No, no, that's not it! I mean, 
I didn't even notice her outfit!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Still, you were looking intently at the 
shop window—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? Ryan-chan, did you tweak your 
hairstyle a bit?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah~~!! I've been found out~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...To be honest, since I was going out 
with Trainer-san today, I put on just a 
little..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. That's why you were staring 
so intently to see if your hair looked 
weird.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... I just kept worrying about 
whether my hair wasn't styled properly or 
something..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Because I fussed over it in a weird way, 
what was supposed to be a breather ended 
up making me feel restless instead.
choice_data_list: Don't worry, it suits you well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hyaah~... T-To think it looks good on 
me...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Jeez! You're telling me way too late!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If you'd just told her from the start, 
Ryan-chan wouldn't have had to be this 
nervous~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, you need to pay a whole lot more 
attention to Ryan-chan!"
choice_data_list: I'll take a closer look next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Taking your time... That's embarrassing in 
its own way, so please stop~!

And so, fully aware of Mejiro Ryan's hard 
work, the three of us returned to the 
academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? Please don't apologize like that! I 
barely even touched it, nobody would 
notice!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Then next time, you should try making an 
even bolder change!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Like trying on the kind of clothes you see 
in shop windows~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? S-Something this cute!? No way, 
no way, no wayyy!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, I really think it'd look good on you, 
though~.

And so, sharing a lively conversation, the 
three of us headed back to the academy.
